answer.text: Selling losing positions to realise capital losses offsetting gains (legitimate, subject to Section 94(7) wash-sale)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Harvest losses to offset gains. Subject to Section 94(7) — can't repurchase within stipulated time. **The Trap:** Entirely legal if wash-sale rules respected. **Cross-Exam Context:** Core tax planning. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Document sale and repurchase timing — avoid wash-sale disallowance.
